segments.text: Day four of 100 Days of Machine Learning: data cleaning, step by step.
segments.caption: Day 4 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: data cleaning, step by step.

segments.text: Eight problems you'll meet in every real dataset, and exactly how to fix each one. Save this one!
segments.caption: 8 problems you'll meet in every real dataset, and exactly how to fix each one. Save this one!

segments.text: Remember our Bangalore flats? Ten thousand rows, straight from the websites.
segments.caption: Remember our Bangalore flats? 10,000 rows, straight from the websites.

segments.text: Feed this to a model as it is, and the predictions are garbage. Let's clean it, in order.
segments.caption: Feed this to a model as it is, and the predictions are garbage. Let's clean it, in order.

segments.text: Step one: data profiling. Before fixing anything, look.
segments.caption: Step 1: data profiling. Before fixing anything, look.

segments.text: Count rows and columns, check each column's type, and count the blanks. Here, price is stored as text, like one point two crore.
segments.caption: Count rows and columns, check each column's type, and count the blanks. Here, price is stored as text, like "1.2 Cr".

segments.text: Now you know what's broken.
segments.caption: Now you know what's broken.

segments.text: Step two: fix types and units.
segments.caption: Step 2: fix types and units.

segments.text: Turn one point two crore into one twenty lakh, and ninety eight L into ninety eight. Convert square metres into square feet. One unit per column, always.
segments.caption: Turn "1.2 Cr" into 120 lakh, and "98 L" into 98. Convert sq m into sq ft. One unit per column, always.

segments.text: Step three: standardise categories.
segments.caption: Step 3: standardise categories.

segments.text: Two BHK, 2bhk and two bedroom all become the number two. Koramangala, spelled four different ways, becomes one. Otherwise the model thinks they're different places.
segments.caption: "2 BHK", "2bhk" and "two bedroom" all become the number 2. Koramangala, spelled 4 different ways, becomes one. Otherwise the model thinks they're different places.

segments.text: Step four: remove duplicates.
segments.caption: Step 4: remove duplicates.

segments.text: Exact copies are easy. The tricky ones: the same flat posted by three brokers, with slightly different prices. Match on area, locality, floor and building, and keep one.
segments.caption: Exact copies are easy. The tricky ones: the same flat posted by 3 brokers, with slightly different prices. Match on area, locality, floor and building, and keep one.

segments.text: Step five: missing values. First ask why it's missing.
segments.caption: Step 5: missing values. First ask why it's missing.

segments.text: If the price is missing, that's what we're predicting, so drop the row. If the floor is missing, fill it with the median for that building. And add a column that says it was missing.
segments.caption: If the price is missing, that's what we're predicting, so drop the row. If the floor is missing, fill it with the median for that building. And add a column that says it was missing.

segments.text: Step six: validity checks. Write simple rules.
segments.caption: Step 6: validity checks. Write simple rules.

segments.text: Area between two hundred and ten thousand square feet. Built year not in the future. A twelve thousand square foot one BHK? Clearly a typo for twelve hundred, so fix it. If you can't tell, remove it.
segments.caption: Area between 200 and 10,000 sq ft. Built year not in the future. A 12,000 sq ft 1 BHK? Clearly a typo for 1,200, so fix it. If you can't tell, remove it.

segments.text: Step seven: outliers. Not errors, just extreme.
segments.caption: Step 7: outliers. Not errors, just extreme.

segments.text: A fifty crore villa is real, but it will pull a flat price model off course. Keep it, cap it, or model villas separately. We covered this in our outlier treatment video.
segments.caption: A 50 crore villa is real, but it will pull a flat price model off course. Keep it, cap it, or model villas separately. We covered this in our outlier treatment video.

segments.text: Step eight: log everything, and re-check.
segments.caption: Step 8: log everything, and re-check.

segments.text: Write down every change, and run the profile again. We went from ten thousand rows to ninety three hundred clean ones. Now the data is ready.
segments.caption: Write down every change, and run the profile again. We went from 10,000 rows to 9,300 clean ones. Now the data is ready.

segments.text: Here's the cleaning checklist, in order.
segments.caption: Here's the cleaning checklist, in order.

segments.text: Profile. Types and units. Categories. Duplicates. Missing values. Validity rules. Outliers. Log and re-check.
segments.caption: Profile. Types and units. Categories. Duplicates. Missing values. Validity rules. Outliers. Log and re-check.
